name: GeoServer
about: The newest GeoServer release on the stable and maintenance lines, plus the last 2.27 release, which is end-of-life.

lines.note: Maintenance line. GeoServer announced 2.28.6 on 19 Oct 2026; its GitHub release is dated 2 Nov.
End-of-life. GeoServer made 2.27.7 for security fixes only and says to plan a move to 2.28 or 3.0.

older: GeoServer 2.26 and older are end-of-life and get no fixes: move to 3.0 or 2.28.

sources.title: GeoServer downloads: 3.0.2 stable, 2.28.6 maintenance, 2.27 and older archived
GeoServer 2.27.7 release, announced 19 Oct 2026: 2.27 is end-of-life, apply as a mitigation only
